properties.description: Detects a coordinated campaign (multiple source IPs, same JA4 fingerprint, same ASN) originating from an ASN previously associated with banned connections or datacenter infrastructure. Correlates with MITRE ATT&CK T1583 (Acquire Infrastructure).
properties.query:
// Step 1: Identify ASNs with at least one banned connection in the past 7 days
let known_bad_asns = JA4proxy_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where ja4proxy_action_s == 'banned'
| distinct ja4proxy_asn_org_s;
// Step 2: Find campaigns from those ASNs in the past 30 minutes
JA4proxy_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30m)
| where ja4proxy_asn_org_s in (known_bad_asns)
| where isnotempty(ja4proxy_fingerprint_s)
| summarize
    UniqueSourceIPs = dcount(source_ip_s),
    TotalConnections = count(),
    BlockedCount = countif(ja4proxy_action_s in ('blocked', 'banned')),
    MaxScore = max(ja4proxy_risk_score_d),
    AvgScore = avg(ja4proxy_risk_score_d),
    TargetSNIs = make_set(ja4proxy_sni_s, 10),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
    by ja4proxy_fingerprint_s, ja4proxy_asn_org_s, bin(TimeGenerated, 30m)
| where UniqueSourceIPs >= 5
| extend
    CampaignLabel = strcat('Campaign: ', ja4proxy_fingerprint_s, ' from ', ja4proxy_asn_org_s),
    BlockRate = round(todouble(BlockedCount) / todouble(TotalConnections) * 100, 1)

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: Coordinated campaign detected from ASN {{ja4proxy_asn_org_s}} using fingerprint {{ja4proxy_fingerprint_s}}. {{UniqueSourceIPs}} distinct source IPs, {{TotalConnections}} total connections ({{BlockRate}}% blocked).
